alignments.name: Khufu — King's Chamber north shaft
alignments.description: Northern shaft of the King's Chamber in the Great Pyramid of Khufu (Giza). Points toward the circumpolar region; around 2560 BCE the star Thuban (α Draconis) passed through this declination.

alignments.name: Khufu — King's Chamber south shaft
alignments.description: Southern shaft of the King's Chamber in the Great Pyramid of Khufu. Elevation and azimuth follow the Rudolf Gantenbrink survey (toward the Orion region in the sky of the Old Kingdom).

alignments.name: Djoser — serdab (north holes)
alignments.description: Serdab on the north side of Djoser's Step Pyramid at Saqqara. The two sight holes in the north wall are inclined ~16–17° toward the northern circumpolar stars, which the Egyptians associated with eternity.

alignments.name: Senenmut — TT353 temple entrance (Deir el-Bahari)
alignments.description: Entrance alignment of the tomb-temple of Senenmut (TT353) at Deir el-Bahari. Azimuth 99° and elevation 25°; search interval covers the likely lifetime of Senenmut under Hatshepsut (1472–1457 BCE).
